chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 556 – The Unstoppable Spear: Red Snow Empyrean God Crushes the Three-Eyed Fiendgod
chapter_meta_description: The Seven Radiance Empyrean God turns the tide of the Realm War! Red Snow’s mastery of Spacetime completely dominates the Three-Eyed Fiendgod, forcing Daofather Ink Bamboo to scramble. The cost of war is laid bare.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 556 – Spacetime Supremacy in the Realm War
og_description: The Seven Radiance Empyrean God turns the tide with a spear that warps reality itself. Fire. Blood. The price of victory.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 556: Red Snow’s Spear Breaks the War!
twitter_description: The Seven Radiance Empyrean God arrives to dominate the battlefield with fused Time and Space Daos. The Seamless Gate’s counterattack fails spectacularly.

lore_anchors.definition: A colossal battle avatar formed by the perfect fusion of seven Empyrean Gods under the command of Chaotic True God Threelives, known for its overwhelming power and refined combat arts.
A battle avatar formed by the three Devouring Mountain demon gods merging their power, representing raw, bestial strength.
The central commander of the Seven Radiance Empyrean God, a legendary ancient being famous for fusing the Grand Daos of Time and Snow (Water) into a unique, dominating combat style.
The third and most ambitious of the Devouring Mountain demon gods, known for his immense pride and desire to prove himself against the ancient legends.
A condensed fragment of a True God Daofather's personal comprehension of Chaos, permanently sacrificed to grant a cultivator a temporary burst of Daofather-threshold power.
A supreme archer of the Three Realms, a Heartforce master at the fourth level of perfection.
A powerful Sword Immortal on the Seamless Gate's side, known for his cold, calculating pragmatism and tendency to retreat from unwinnable fights.
A dragon-shaped war formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals.
Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
The unified Dao resulting from the fusion of the Grand Dao of Time and the Grand Dao of Space, a legendary achievement that grants a cultivator the power to warp reality itself.
